title: Generate date/time
text:
Breadcrumbs
The
Generate date/time
building block generates a date/time value containing the current system date and time.
Fully expanded, the
Generate date/time
block shows the following properties:
Note:
The screenshot on this page uses the
Elegance Design
, introduced in
2025.3
. If you are using an earlier version, your layout may look different.
Quick-start
Drag
Generate date/time
onto the canvas.
Connect the block in the flow. Trigger it where you need the current date/time, and use
Date/time
later in the flow. Optionally, you can expand and use the individual date and time parts.
Run the flow when it’s ready.
Building block parameters
Parameters
Block header
: The green input connector triggers the block to execute and generate the current date/time value. The green output connector triggers when the date/time value has been generated. You can rename the block title (“Generate date/time”) by double-clicking it and typing a new title.
Date/time
: The current system date/time value. You can expand it to use the individual date and time values separately, including
Year
,
Month
,
Day
,
Hour
,
Minute
, and
Second
(and
Millisecond
where available).
